rows_data = cells('Knot measurements', 'B702:C706')
pts = sorted(rows_data, key=lambda x: x[0])
# Helper to get interpolated Y at any X within range
def get_y(x_val):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[i+1]
        if x1 <= x_val <= x2:
            if x1 == x2:
                return y1
            return y1 + (y2 - y1) * (x_val - x1) / (x2 - x1)
    return None
x_start = 2.0
x_end = 18.0
# Trapezoidal integration with subsegments at knot points between x_start and x_end
all_x = [x_start] + [p[0] for p in pts if x_start < p[0] < x_end] + [x_end]
all_x = sorted(list(set(all_x)))
area = 0.0
for i in range(len(all_x)-1):
    xa = all_x[i]
    xb = all_x[i+1]
    ya = get_y(xa)
    yb = get_y(xb)
    area += 0.5 * (ya + yb) * (xb - xa)
result = round(area, 2)
